title: Purpose and interpretation of the t-test

cues.en: Instructor: This section of the course is all about the t-test.
cues.zh: 講師：這一章都在談 t 檢定。

cues.en: The t-test is one of the most important and the most commonly used statistics in basically all of applied statistics.
cues.zh: t 檢定基本上是應用統計中最重要、最常使用的統計方法之一。

cues.en: So it's really important.
cues.zh: 所以非常重要。

cues.en: So if you are not really familiar with the t-test, then buckle in and get ready to learn.
cues.zh: 如果還不熟悉，就坐穩，準備學習。

cues.en: This is going to be a really exciting section and I think you will feel your brain growing with each video in this section.
cues.zh: 這一章會很精彩，我想每看一部影片，都會感覺腦袋在成長。

cues.en: Okay so, and in this particular video, this is a bit of an introductory video to this section, I'm going to explain the general idea of a t-test and the general formula of the t-test.
cues.zh: 這部影片是本章的簡介，會解釋 t 檢定的一般概念和一般公式。

cues.en: I call these general and basic.
cues.zh: 我稱為一般、基本。

cues.en: I'm using these terms, because you'll see throughout the next dozen or so videos that there are specific variants of a t-test that are all a little bit different from each other,
cues.zh: 之所以用這些詞，是因為接下來十幾部影片會看到，t 檢定有不同變形，彼此略有差異，

cues.en: based on different assumptions, different things that you're testing.
cues.zh: 根據不同假設、不同檢驗對象。

cues.en: But all of the t-tests have a kind of, they have this same fundamental architecture, this kind of skeleton that they all look like.
cues.zh: 但所有 t 檢定都有相同的基本架構、骨架。

cues.en: And that's the general formula that I'm going to illustrate to you.
cues.zh: 這就是要介紹的一般公式。

cues.en: And I'll also show you how to derive a p-value.
cues.zh: 也會說明如何推導 P 值。

cues.en: And towards the end of this video, I will show you three different methods, three different ways to make sure that you are getting a large t-statistic
cues.zh: 影片最後，會展示三種方法，確保真正有效果時，能得到很大的 t 統計量，

cues.en: when you actually have a real effect, so basically, three ways of getting a significant result from your t-test.
cues.zh: 基本上就是三種讓 t 檢定得到顯著結果的方法。

cues.en: So let's begin.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: The main idea of a t-test is to compare the values, typically the means between two different groups.
cues.zh: t 檢定主要是比較兩組的數值，通常是平均值。

cues.en: So that's our hypothesis that the data in the blue group have a different mean from the data in the green group.
cues.zh: 假設藍組資料和綠組資料有不同平均值。

cues.en: So these guys, as a group, are different from these guys.
cues.zh: 這一群整體而言，和那一群不同。

cues.en: That doesn't mean that each individual member needs to be different from each individual member.
cues.zh: 不是說每個個體都必須和另一組每個個體不同。

cues.en: So we can take an example of heights of adult men and adult women.
cues.zh: 例如成年男性和成年女性的身高。

cues.en: Now, in general, adult men are taller than adult women.
cues.zh: 一般成年男性比成年女性高。

cues.en: But that doesn't mean that every single man is gonna be taller than every single woman.
cues.zh: 但不代表每一個男性都比每一個女性高。

cues.en: Of course, there are plenty of women, who are taller than plenty of men.
cues.zh: 當然，有很多女性比很多男性高。

cues.en: So the idea of the t-test is to determine whether as a group, this group has a larger mean, or a mean that is different from the mean of this group.
cues.zh: t 檢定要判斷的，是整組而言，這組平均值是否較大，或和另一組平均值不同。

cues.en: So that's the alternative hypothesis.
cues.zh: 這是對立假設。

cues.en: We can contrast that with the null hypothesis of a t-test, which says that the means of the two groups are equal.
cues.zh: 相對地，t 檢定的虛無假設，是兩組平均值相同。

cues.en: And that would mean that basically we could shuffle around the group assignment and it wouldn't really significantly change the means a lot.
cues.zh: 基本上表示，打亂群組分配，不會讓平均值改變很多。

cues.en: This random shuffling of data values into different group assignments is also the basis for permutation testing for t-tests.
cues.zh: 隨機打亂資料值的群組歸屬，也是 t 檢定置換檢定的基礎。

cues.en: And I'll get to that at the end of this section.
cues.zh: 本章最後會談。

cues.en: So I'm describing this here as if there were two groups that we're testing, this group against this group.
cues.zh: 這裡描述得像有兩組，比較這組與那組。

cues.en: It's also possible to test this group against, well, nothing.
cues.zh: 也可以把這組和，嗯，沒有另一組的情況比較。

cues.en: But then implicitly, we're testing against zero.
cues.zh: 但隱含地，是和 0 比較。

cues.en: So we imagine that this group has a mean value of zero.
cues.zh: 想像這一組平均值為 0。

cues.en: And this group, we test whether the mean here is significantly different from zero.
cues.zh: 再檢驗這組平均值是否顯著不同於 0。

cues.en: Obviously, that doesn't make sense in the case of height.
cues.zh: 身高這個例子顯然不合理。

cues.en: But you can imagine a situation where we're testing whether some particular medication, maybe it's a new vitamin,
cues.zh: 但可以想像，測試某種特定藥物，也許是一種新維他命，

cues.en: let's say a new vitamin makes people feel happier with their life.
cues.zh: 看看是否讓人對生活感到更快樂。

cues.en: So they take a new vitamin and then we see whether the effect that that vitamin has is different from zero.
cues.zh: 服用新維他命，再看效果是否不同於 0。

cues.en: Okay, so this is the basic idea of the t-test.
cues.zh: 這就是 t 檢定的基本概念。

cues.en: We are testing one group against another, or one group against a value of zero.
cues.zh: 檢驗一組對另一組，或一組對 0。

cues.en: And here is the general formula for the t-test.
cues.zh: 這是一般公式。

cues.en: So I encourage you to write this down, or commit this to memory.
cues.zh: 鼓勵你寫下來，或記住。

cues.en: Somehow, remember this t-test formula.
cues.zh: 用某種方式記住 t 檢定公式。

cues.en: As I mentioned in the very beginning of this video, not every single formula for all the variants of a t-test, will look exactly like this.
cues.zh: 一開始提過，並不是所有 t 檢定變形的公式，都恰好長這樣。

cues.en: But they will all look kind of like this.
cues.zh: 但都大致相似。

cues.en: So once you have this template formula memorized, it's gonna be really easy to learn all of the other variants of a t-test.
cues.zh: 記住這個樣板公式，就很容易學其他變形。

cues.en: So what are these terms here?
cues.zh: 這些項目是什麼？

cues.en: So this is X-bar and Y-bar.
cues.zh: X 上橫線和 Y 上橫線。

cues.en: This is the average of group one and the average of group two.
cues.zh: 第一組平均值，以及第二組平均值。

cues.en: And this is S, this is the standard deviation, the sample standard deviation, divided by the square-root of n.
cues.zh: 這是 s，標準差、樣本標準差，再除以 n 的平方根。

cues.en: So n is the number of samples, S is the standard deviation.
cues.zh: n 是樣本數，s 是標準差。

cues.en: Again, the precise details of exactly how this formula looks, will differ and you'll see throughout this section, different variants of this formula.
cues.zh: 公式確切細節會不同，本章會看到各種變形。

cues.en: But they all look kind of like this.
cues.zh: 但大致都像這樣。

cues.en: Okay and the way to think about this formula, you can memorize some letters and horizontal lines and things like that.
cues.zh: 可以背字母、水平線之類的。

cues.en: But the way to think about this formula and the way to internalize what a t-test is really measuring, is the difference of means divided by standard deviations.
cues.zh: 但真正理解公式、內化 t 檢定量測什麼的方式，是平均值之差除以標準差。

cues.en: And that's the general way to think about that.
cues.zh: 這是一般理解方式。

cues.en: So a difference of the means, divided by or scaled by, we could say normalized by the standard deviation.
cues.zh: 平均值之差，除以、縮放，或說用標準差正規化。

cues.en: Okay, so because of sampling variability, there's going to be a range of t-values that you could expect, even if the null hypothesis were true.
cues.zh: 因為抽樣變異，即使虛無假設為真，仍可預期有一個 t 值範圍。

cues.en: So that's what we have here, the probability of a certain t-value occurring, given that the null hypothesis is true.
cues.zh: 這裡是在虛無假設為真時，某個 t 值出現的機率。

cues.en: So if the null hypothesis is true, then we say the difference of the means for the two groups is zero.
cues.zh: 虛無假設為真，就說兩組平均差為 0。

cues.en: We would expect this to be zero.
cues.zh: 預期這裡為 0。

cues.en: So the expectation value of the t-statistic under the null hypothesis is zero.
cues.zh: 所以虛無假設下，t 統計量的期望值為 0。

cues.en: But of course, there's sampling variability, there's noise, there's all sorts of things that will push the t-value around a little bit.
cues.zh: 但有抽樣變異、雜訊、各種因素，會讓 t 值稍微移動。

cues.en: So therefore, this is the distribution of t-value that we can expect under the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 因此，這是虛無假設下可預期的 t 值分布。

cues.en: And then the idea of determining statistical significance and deriving a p-value from a t-value, is to compare the t-value that you actually observed in your real data
cues.zh: 判斷統計顯著性、由 t 值取得 P 值，就是將實際資料觀察到的 t 值，

cues.en: against this analytic distribution, this theoretical probability function of getting a particular t-value, given that the null hypothesis is true.
cues.zh: 和這個解析分布比較，也就是虛無假設為真時，得到某個 t 值的理論機率函數。

cues.en: So for example, let's say we collect some data and we take a sample of men and we measure their height and we take a sample of women and we measure their height.
cues.zh: 例如收集資料，抽男性樣本測身高，再抽女性樣本測身高。

cues.en: And we get the variance or the standard deviation, the sample standard deviation and the square-root of the number of individuals that we have.
cues.zh: 取得變異數、標準差，樣本標準差，以及個體數的平方根。

cues.en: And that ratio turns out to be, let's say it's around 1.5.
cues.zh: 這個比值假設約為 1.5。

cues.en: So then we want to know what is the probability of observing a t-statistic of 1.5 or greater, given that the null hypothesis is actually true?
cues.zh: 想知道，在虛無假設為真時，觀察到 t=1.5 或更大的機率是多少？

cues.en: Well, I'm just kind of more or less making up this number, it turns out that that p-value, that probability value is 0.065
cues.zh: 這個數字大致是我編的，P 值為 0.065，

cues.en: with a certain degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 在某個特定自由度下。

cues.en: So there are k degrees of freedom associated with a t-statistic.
cues.zh: t 統計量有 k 個自由度。

cues.en: And you'll learn more in later videos how to determine the number of degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 之後影片會介紹如何決定自由度數量。

cues.en: So the p-value associated with this particular t-value is 0.065.
cues.zh: 這個特定 t 值所對應 P 值為 0.065。

cues.en: Now we have to come up with a statistical significance threshold.
cues.zh: 接著要設定統計顯著性門檻。

cues.en: And as you now know, that's typically set to be 0.05.
cues.zh: 你現在知道，通常設為 0.05。

cues.en: So this value is actually larger than 0.05.
cues.zh: 這個 P 值其實比 0.05 大。

cues.en: This observed t-statistic is smaller than the threshold for this degree of freedom and p of 0.05.
cues.zh: 觀察到的 t 統計量，比這個自由度、P=0.05 下的門檻小。

cues.en: So in this particular case, we would actually say that the t-statistic is not statistically significant.
cues.zh: 所以這個情況，會說 t 統計量不具有統計顯著性。

cues.en: We do not have sufficient evidence to reject the null hypothesis in favor of the alternative hypothesis that these two groups are equal.
cues.zh: 沒有足夠證據拒絕虛無假設，傾向這兩組相等的對立假設。

cues.en: And again, just as a little bit of reiteration, because it's an important point, having a p-value that is larger than 0.05 does not mean that we have evidence
cues.zh: 再重複一下，因為很重要，P 值大於 0.05，不表示有證據

cues.en: that these two groups have the same mean.
cues.zh: 證明兩組平均相同。

cues.en: So we're not showing that these groups have the same mean.
cues.zh: 不是在證明兩組平均相同。

cues.en: Instead, we are just failing to find sufficient evidence that these means are different from each other.
cues.zh: 只是沒有找到足夠證據，顯示平均值彼此不同。

cues.en: All right, so the last thing that I want to discuss here in this video, is the three different ways to maximize your t-value.
cues.zh: 最後要談三種讓 t 值最大的方式。

cues.en: And you want to maximize your t-value, because you want your t-value to be far away from zero.
cues.zh: 想讓 t 值最大，是因為希望遠離 0。

cues.en: It can be large-positive, it can be large-negative.
cues.zh: 可以是很大的正數，或很大的負數。

cues.en: But you can see that the larger the t-values are in magnitude, the smaller the p-values are going to be.
cues.zh: 可以看到，t 值的絕對大小越大，P 值就越小。

cues.en: And that's what we want, is statistically significant t-statistics, of course, when there is a real effect out there in the world.
cues.zh: 想要的是統計顯著的 t 統計量，當然前提是現實真的有效果。

cues.en: Okay, so what I do here is rewrite this formula in just a slightly different way, putting the square-root of n in the numerator, just to make it a little bit easier to interpret.
cues.zh: 這裡把公式稍微改寫，將 n 的平方根放分子，比較容易解讀。

cues.en: So you can see I can do that, because there's a division in the denominator.
cues.zh: 因為分母中有除法，所以可以這樣做。

cues.en: So it gets a little confusing.
cues.zh: 有點容易混淆。

cues.en: But when you're dividing by something in the denominator, that's the same thing as putting it in the numerator.
cues.zh: 但分母中除以某個量，就等於把該量放到分子。

cues.en: Okay, so notice, I've done three different colors here.
cues.zh: 注意，這裡用了三種顏色。

cues.en: I have three different colors.
cues.zh: 有三種不同顏色。

cues.en: So that leads to our three different ways of getting a large t-statistic.
cues.zh: 對應三種得到大 t 統計量的方法。

cues.en: So one is we can have large group differences.
cues.zh: 第一，群組差異很大。

cues.en: So get the mean of group X to be really different from the mean of group Y.
cues.zh: 讓 X 組平均和 Y 組平均差很多。

cues.en: Two is to have small variances, so to reduce the total amount of variability in the dataset.
cues.zh: 第二，變異數小，降低資料集中總變異程度。

cues.en: And three is to increase the sample size.
cues.zh: 第三，增加樣本數。

cues.en: So you can see that even when the variability, the standard deviation is the same and when the two groups have exactly the same means,
cues.zh: 即使變異、標準差相同，而且兩組平均值完全相同，

cues.en: if we increase n, then we get a larger t.
cues.zh: 增加 n，就能得到更大的 t。

cues.en: Now that's not a linear relationship, it's a square-root relationship.
cues.zh: 不是線性關係，是平方根關係。

cues.en: But for the same group differences and the same variability, simply collecting more data is going to increase the value
cues.zh: 在相同群組差異、相同變異下，只要收集更多資料，就會增加

cues.en: of t.
cues.zh: t 的值。

cues.en: By the way, I haven't mentioned this explicitly, but you can also see that the sign of the t-test is arbitrary.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，雖然沒明說，但也看得出 t 檢定的正負號是任意的。

cues.en: It's really just X minus Y or Y minus X.
cues.zh: 只是 X−Y 或 Y−X。

cues.en: That difference in magnitude will be the same.
cues.zh: 差值的絕對大小相同。

cues.en: It just determines which sign is going to be flipped.
cues.zh: 只決定哪個方向翻轉正負號。

cues.en: And this is something I've discussed previously in this course that that sign is arbitrary.
cues.zh: 課程之前討論過，正負號可以自行選擇。

cues.en: X minus Y or Y minus X doesn't change the statistic.
cues.zh: X−Y 或 Y−X，不改變統計量。

cues.en: It's not gonna change the p-value, but one way is generally, sort of a little bit easier to interpret, given how you set up your experiment.
cues.zh: 不改變 P 值，但根據實驗設定，某個方向通常比較容易解讀。

cues.en: And I think the example I used before, was with comparing the heights of giraffes to the heights of slow lorises.
cues.zh: 我想先前用的例子，是比較長頸鹿和懶猴身高。

cues.en: So there, it's kind of sensible to say giraffe minus slow loris, so that the t-value is positive.
cues.zh: 這時用長頸鹿減懶猴很合理，讓 t 值為正。

cues.en: Okay, but anyway, the reason why I wanted to make these three things clear, these three factors, these ways of increasing your t-value, is that in different kinds of research
cues.zh: 總之，特別說明這三個因素、三種增加 t 值的方式，是因為不同研究，

cues.en: and different kinds of experiments, you may or may not have control over some of these different factors.
cues.zh: 不同實驗中，不一定都能控制這些因素。

cues.en: So for example, if you are measuring from a system that you know, before you start your experiment, you know that your system is pretty noisy,
cues.zh: 例如測量某個系統，實驗前就知道系統雜訊很大，

cues.en: you know you're gonna have a high amount of variability and there's nothing you can do about that, then you need to make sure either that you're looking for effects that will be large in magnitude,
cues.zh: 知道變異會很高，而且無法改變，那就必須確保研究的效果幅度大，

cues.en: or that you're going to collect a large amount of data.
cues.zh: 或者收集大量資料。

cues.en: We can turn this around, I can give you another example.
cues.zh: 反過來，再給一個例子。

cues.en: Let's imagine you are doing research on schizophrenia patients between the ages of 60 and 70.
cues.zh: 假設研究 60 到 70 歲的思覺失調症患者。

cues.en: So some clinical research project and it's probably not going to be very easy to find a very large group of schizophrenia patients
cues.zh: 某個臨床研究，可能不容易找到非常多

cues.en: between the ages of 60 and 70.
cues.zh: 60 到 70 歲的思覺失調症患者。

cues.en: So you know that n is gonna be small.
cues.zh: 所以知道 n 會小。

cues.en: So you need to design your research to make sure either that the effect size is large, or that the variability is very small.
cues.zh: 就必須設計研究，確保效果量大，或者變異很小。

cues.en: Because you're certainly not going to be able to increase your t-value based on n.
cues.zh: 因為肯定無法靠 n 增加 t 值。

cues.en: Okay, so that is the general introduction to the t-test.
cues.zh: 這是 t 檢定的一般介紹。

cues.en: I told you about the kind of the framework, the skeleton of a t-test.
cues.zh: 說明其架構、骨架。

cues.en: And the main concept to remember, is that it's a difference of means, divided by a standard deviation.
cues.zh: 主要概念是，平均值之差除以標準差。

cues.en: Now over the next several videos, you will see more specifically how these different variants of a t-test are related to specific assumptions and specific ways
cues.zh: 接下來幾部影片會更具體說明，不同 t 檢定變形如何對應特定假設，以及特定的

cues.en: of designing your hypothesis.
cues.zh: 研究假設設計方式。
